gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all workflow schemes to understand the current configurations across projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all workflow schemes available in the Jira instance.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new workflow scheme to associate with my project.
gold.ideal: Creates a new workflow scheme and returns the details of the created scheme.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to read specific workflow schemes to analyze their configurations for integration.
gold.ideal: Reads and returns the specified workflow schemes based on the provided criteria.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to update existing workflow schemes to reflect changes in our processes.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified workflow schemes and returns the updated details.

gold.user: As a system admin, I need to delete obsolete workflow schemes to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified workflow scheme and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to view the details of a specific workflow scheme to ensure it meets our requirements.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I need to update the workflow scheme to include new steps.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified workflow scheme and returns the updated scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira admin, I want to remove the default workflow from a scheme that is no longer in use.
gold.ideal: Deletes the default workflow from the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to check the default workflow for a scheme to ensure it aligns with our processes.
gold.ideal: Returns the default workflow associated with the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to set a new default workflow for a workflow scheme.
gold.ideal: Updates the default workflow for the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to remove an issue type from a workflow scheme that is no longer relevant.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified issue type from the workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to check which workflow scheme is associated with a specific issue type.
gold.ideal: Returns the workflow scheme associated with the specified issue type.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to associate a new issue type with a workflow scheme.
gold.ideal: Sets the specified issue type for the workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a system admin, I need to remove a workflow mapping that is no longer used.
gold.ideal: Deletes the workflow mapping from the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to view the workflow associated with a specific workflow scheme.
gold.ideal: Returns the workflow associated with the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I need to update the workflow mapping to reflect new project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the workflow mapping for the specified workflow scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to see which projects are using a specific workflow scheme.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of projects that are currently using the specified workflow scheme.
